extDescription.message: Limit distracting sites and stay focused with schedules, blocklists, and in-app filters.

ui_brand_name.description: Product name in popup and dashboard header.

card_empty_sites.message: No sites in this group yet.

popup_note_tracking.message: Time is being tracked for this site.

popup_note_time_up.message: Time for this site has run out.

popup_url_unreadable.message: Could not read the current tab URL.

popup_show_toggle_label.message: Show extension on/off switch in the popup

popup_show_toggle_hint.message: Turn off to hide the switch and avoid turning the extension off by mistake.

popup_floating_timer_hint.message: Show a floating countdown while browsing (if supported).

popup_local_only_label.message: Store dashboard settings on this device only

popup_local_only_hint.message: Disables Chrome sync for dashboard settings; other data is unchanged.

popup_open_full_dashboard_hint.message: Blocking rules, schedule, notifications, and advanced options are in the dashboard.

opening_timer_footer.message: You cannot skip this. The popup will open when the countdown ends.

opening_timer_message_default.message: Take a short pause before opening distracting content.

blocked_allowonly_title.message: Block everything except the allow list

blocked_allowonly_desc_html.message: When enabled, only entries in the Allow list tab can open; all other URLs are blocked while the extension is on. Block groups below are locked because they do not apply in this mode.

allow_intro_html.message:
This list only always allows URLs that match what you add (domain, ^word, ^url — same syntax as blocked sites). Pages not listed here still work normally unless blocked by groups / blocklist / timers.
Only when Block everything except the allow list is enabled in the Blocked tab are all other URLs blocked.

allow_empty.message: No sites in the allow list yet.

allow_modal_desc_add_html.message: One line per item: domain, ^word to allow (URL match), or ^url (e.g. ^https://…, ^/reels/) — same rules as Add blocked sites.

allow_modal_desc_edit_html.message: Edit the entry (same syntax: domain, ^word, ^url). Save replaces the current item.

custom_subtitle.message: Place your form, domain field, category, or block rules in this panel (placeholder UI).

inapp_yt_desc.message: Hide Shorts, comments, recommendations, and more on YouTube.

inapp_fb_desc.message: Filter the Facebook feed: sidebar, posts, ads, keywords, and more.

inapp_yt_intro.message: Block specific YouTube features like Shorts, comments, or more.

inapp_fb_intro_html.message: Master switches only enable or disable editing child options. Child toggles do not auto-follow the master — each child state is saved. Use arrows to expand or collapse sections.

yt_hint_hide_topbar.message: Hide the top bar including the search box

yt_hint_disable_endcards.message: Hide recommendations shown in the player at the end of videos

yt_hint_grayscale.message: Show YouTube in grayscale to reduce visual stimulation

yt_hint_disable_autoplay.message: Do not autoplay the next video after the current one ends

yt_hint_theater.message: Automatically use theater mode on watch pages after in-page navigation

yt_hint_skip_ads.message: Hide ad visuals, fast-forward ad segments, and click Skip when it appears

yt_hint_opening_timer.message: Add a short wait before the page opens to build patience

sch_intro.message: Pick days and hours when time limits apply. Sites on the allow list still open normally.

sch_active_days_lead.message: Choose the days when scheduled limits run.

sch_active_days_detail.message: Only checked days use scheduled limits (with Active hours). If no day is checked, scheduled limits are off.

sch_clear_days_hint.message: Uncheck all days to turn off scheduled limits (list blocking still follows your extension settings).

sch_active_hours_desc.message: Time window for every enabled day above (same start–end all week).

sch_daily_reset_desc_html.message: Reset remaining time (siteTimers) every day at this clock — only for hostnames in your block lists / groups.

sch_tip_html.message: Data is stored in vmuActiveSchedule (Chrome sync). Legacy vmuFocusSchedule is read once when you first open this tab.

settings_general_desc.message: Appearance, popup behavior, countdown alerts, redirect text, and privacy.

settings_activate_desc_html.message: Turn on to show the Active toggle on the popup; turn off to hide it (option hideSwitch).

settings_floating_timer_hint.message: Show a floating countdown while browsing (if supported).

settings_disable_sync_hint.message: Keep dashboard settings on this device only, not synced to your account.

settings_track_audio_hint.message: Use audio playback as part of focus tracking.

settings_hide_allow_links_hint.message: Hide shortcuts / bypass links on block screens.

settings_redirect_hint.message: Shown when the user is redirected away from distracting content.

settings_redirect_placeholder.message: Take a breath and get back to your task.

settings_notif_hint.message: Warnings before time runs out (stored in seconds).

help_block_title.message: How to add a blocked site

help_block_html.message: Open the Blocked sites tab, pick a group, then tap Add blocked sites to add a domain, ^blocked phrase, or ^url.

help_custom_title.message: How to create a custom rule

help_custom_body.message: Open the Custom website tab to set per-site rules (coming soon).

blocked_modal_sites_label_html.message: One line per domain, ^blocked phrase (one ^ at line start), or ^https://… / ^path for URL rules.

blocked_modal_sites_hints_html.message:
• Many sites: one line per item.
  • Phrase block: ^phrase — one per line, one ^ at the start; URLs containing the phrase are blocked.
  • URL block: ^https://…, or ^youtube.com/watch, or ^/shorts/ — match is case-insensitive substring.
  • You can omit https://; path after the domain is optional for plain domains.

card_modal_add_intro_html.message: One line per item: domain, ^phrase, or ^url (e.g. ^https://…, ^/reels/).

card_modal_hints_html.message:
• Many sites: one line per item.
  • Phrase: ^phrase — one ^ at line start.
  • URL: ^ + link or path segment.
  • Omit https:// when you only need the domain.

card_clear_sites_aria.message: Delete all blocked sites in this group

allow_modal_hints_html.message:
• Many sites: one line per item.
  • Allow by phrase: ^phrase — one per line, one ^ at the start.
  • Allow by URL: ^ + link or path (including /, ?, or domain-only).
  • You do not need https://; you can omit the path after the domain for a plain domain.
